name: Daily Crossword: One a Day
subtitle: One free puzzle. Every day.
description:
One new crossword each day. Always free.

• 3,000 unique mini crosswords
• Automatic progress saves
• Continue unfinished puzzles anytime
• Keep every completed puzzle
• Works offline

No ads. No account. No subscriptions.

A fresh puzzle unlocks each day at local midnight. Your puzzle library never repeats.
reviewNotes: No sign-in, payments, ads, tracking, or server connection. Tap New puzzle to start today's crossword. Tap a square to select it; tap again at a crossing to change direction. Use the letter keys, Clues, and Check. Home lists unfinished and completed puzzles. One new puzzle can be started per local calendar day; returning to any saved puzzle is unlimited. The app includes 3,000 original, connected mini crisscross grids. The next puzzle ID and start date are preserved in Keychain; progress is stored locally. No data is collected. The privacy/support link opens the system browser.
